t: Memo Re Miss Praskovia Ilynishna Rimareno

pages.en:
SPECIAL MUNICIPAL POLICE
C.I.D. FILES.
No. C. 11. 603.
Date...26..10..29.

October 26, 29.

Dear Hill,

In reply to your memo of October 24
regarding Miss Praskovia Ilynis'na Rimarenco, there
is nothing on Police Records to the detriment of
this lady, but enquiries show that she was born in
Kishinoff & arrived in Shanghai from Vladivostock
five years ago. Since her arrival here she has
followed no regular employment although she
professes to be a milliner. For two months during
the summer of 1929 she opened a house at 36 Ruhang
Road supposedly as a brothel but was forced to close
down as she was unable to get any females to reside
there . She then proceeded to Tsingtao for some
time. Prior to removing to 36 Ruhang Road she
lived at 177 Broadway which address is known to
the C.I.D. as a brothel, and on return from Tsingtao
again took up residence there. She does not reside
at 12A Kingping Road as stated, but gave that
address in order to conceal the fact that she
resides at 177 Broadway.

Yours sincerely,

J. C. Hill, Esq.,
Passport Office,
H.B.M. Consulate General.

特别市警察
刑事侦缉处档案。
编号 C. 11. 603。
日期...26..10..29。

1929年10月26日。

亲爱的希尔：

关于您10月24日就普拉斯科维娅·伊林尼什娜·里马连科小姐（Miss Praskovia Ilynis'na Rimarenco）一事所发的备忘录，现回复如下：警方记录中并无不利于这位女士的记载，但经查询显示，她出生于基希讷乌（Kishinoff），五年前从符拉迪沃斯托克抵达上海。自抵沪以来，她虽自称从事女帽商职业，但并未受雇于任何固定工作。在1929年夏季的两个月中，她在汝航路36号开设了一处房屋，名义上作为妓院，但因无法招揽到女性居住而被迫关闭。随后她前往青岛停留了一段时间。在搬至汝航路36号之前，她居住在百老汇路177号，该地址被刑事侦缉处知悉为一家妓院，而从青岛返回后，她再次在此居住。她并不如所述居住在昆明路12A号，而是提供该地址以掩盖其实际居住在百老汇路177号的事实。

此致

敬礼

J. C. 希尔先生，
护照办公室，
英国驻上海总领事馆。

POLITICAL BRANCH
(FOREIGN SECTION)
DATE 25.10.29
(C.I.D.) Office Notes
File No. D. 603.

Sir,

With reference to the attached memo. of 24.10.29
from the British Consulate re: Miss Praskovia Ilynishna
Rimareno, I beg to report that there is nothing in Police
records concerning her. The following, however, has been
ascertained as the result of investigations made.

Miss Praskovia Ilynishna Rimareno was born in
Kishinoff, and arrived in Shanghai from Vladivostock five
years ago. Since her arrival here she has followed no
regular employment although she professes to be a milliner.
For two months during the summer of 1929 she opened a
house at 36 Yuhang Road supposedly as a brothel but was
forced to close down as she was unable to get any females
to reside there. She then proceeded to Tsingtao for some
time. Prior to removing to 36 Yuhang Road she lived at
177 Broadway which address is known to the C.I.D. as a
brothel, and on return from Tsingtao again took up residence
there.

She does not reside at 12A. Kungping Road as stated
in the Memo. from the British Consulate General but gave
that address in order to conceal the fact that she resides
at 177 Broadway.

A. Robertson
D. I.

A/D. C. I.
25.10.29.

普拉斯科维娅·伊林尼什娜·里马连科小姐出生于基希讷乌（Kishinoff），五年前从符拉迪沃斯托克抵达上海。自抵沪以来，她虽自称从事女帽商职业，但并未受雇于任何固定工作。在1929年夏季的两个月中，她在余杭路36号开设了一处房屋，名义上作为妓院，但因无法招揽到女性居住而被迫关闭。随后她前往青岛停留了一段时间。在搬至余杭路36号之前，她居住在百老汇路177号，该地址被刑事侦缉处知悉为一家妓院，而从青岛返回后，她再次在此居住。

她并不如英国总领事馆备忘录中所述居住在公平路12A号，而是提供该地址以掩盖其实际居住在百老汇路177号的事实。

A. 罗伯逊
